design: 2 framings x 7 items (3 NONE + 4 fallacy controls, one per mechanism) x 2 models x 15 reps = 420 calls
power: CORRECTED: the earlier figure ('McNemar on 90 NONE pairs: 0.97-1.00') treated 15 reps of 3 items as 90 independent observations. Cluster-aware truth: 3 NONE items x 2 models = 6 CLUSTERS; McNemar power at a 0.139->0.50 rise is 0.03 at 15 reps, not 1.00. Reps cannot fix it (cluster count caps power); items can — 10 NONE items x 2 models x 6 reps gives 0.98.
primary_test: CORRECTED: McNemar at the (item,model) CELL level — cell = majority vote over reps. Reps reduce measurement noise WITHIN a cell; they are NOT units. The prior wording 'paired within item+model+rep' pre-registered the trial-level independence error retracted earlier this session.
control_test: fallacy-item accuracy must NOT drop under B; if it does, B traded one bias for another

stopping_rule.H_bias: NONE rate under B >= 0.50 and controls hold -> difficulty is OUR wording; reword stem and re-run the whole sound-arg class
stopping_rule.H_deficit: NONE rate under B < 0.30 and controls hold -> deficit survives; sound-arg graduates with framing effect bounded
stopping_rule.inconclusive: fallacy controls drop under B -> redesign the neutral stem
